content:
DesignLanguageDocument:
  Intentions:
    purpose: "Establish a universal design language for constructing and evolving narrative universes—cohesive storyworlds that transcend individual media, allowing for immersive storytelling, audience engagement, and cultural depth."
    values:
      - "Inclusivity"
      - "CulturalRespect"
      - "Sustainability"
      - "Adaptability"
      - "MoralIntegrity"
      - "NarrativeContinuity"
    scope: "Applicable to any narrative domain—literary series, transmedia franchises, interactive storyworlds, or conceptual frameworks spanning diverse forms."
    futureOrientation: "Designed for modular updates, iterative refinement, and responsiveness to audience feedback, cultural shifts, and technological advancements. Future AI models can integrate new layers or adapt patterns while preserving core principles."

  Steps:
    Step1_GlobalLexicon:
      coreTier:
        - concept: "CosmicPrinciple"
          attributes: ["defining_universe_theme", "mythic_anchors"]
        - concept: "CulturalArchetype"
          attributes: ["shared_symbols", "traditional_rituals"]
        - concept: "FocalLocale"
          attributes: ["key_geographic_hub", "resource_distribution_center"]
      expansionTier:
        notes: "Optional expansions detailing historical evolution of each concept, local linguistic variants, or specialized narrative tropes."
    
    Step2_CoreEssenceAndPatterns:
      coreTier:
        - pattern: "EmotionalArc"
          description: "Narratives cultivate emotional journeys—hope, loss, triumph—driving audience investment."
        - pattern: "CulturalLayering"
          description: "Storyworlds integrate multiple cultural influences, historical strata, and interwoven traditions."
        - pattern: "AdaptiveContinuity"
          description: "Universes evolve through time, absorbing new influences, allowing sequels, spin-offs, and re-interpretations."
      expansionTier:
        notes: "For deeper context, highlight how patterns manifest differently across genres, eras, or audience demographics."
    
    Step3_MasterKey:
      coreTier:
        - integrator: "UnifiedSeedConcept"
          role: "A single foundational theme or myth informs all narrative decisions."
        - integrator: "InterconnectedScales"
          role: "Micro-level details (characters, artifacts) echo macro-level motifs (cosmic forces, grand conflicts)."
        - integrator: "EquilibriumOfContrasts"
          role: "Tension between dualities (tradition/innovation, local/global, heroism/ambiguity) fuels narrative dynamism."
      expansionTier:
        notes: "Theoretical parallels (linguistic universals, cognitive narrative theory) can be added if needed."
    
    Step4_ImplementationGuidelines:
      coreTier:
        text_narratives:
          - "Anchor main plot arcs in core seed concept; maintain consistent thematic tone."
          - "Vary pacing and scene structures to sustain rhythmic engagement."
        visual_representations:
          - "Reflect cultural layering in architectural motifs, costumes, symbolic color choices."
          - "Use consistent iconography for recurring factions, ideologies, or mythic elements."
        interactive_media:
          - "Provide branching story paths that mirror universal patterns, enabling user-driven narrative evolution."
          - "Integrate feedback loops to incorporate audience/player choices into subsequent expansions."
      expansionTier:
        notes: "Optional scenario-based instructions, advanced storytelling techniques, or localization strategies."
    
    Step5_ImplementationStrategies:
      coreTier:
        - "Regularly review and update core lexicon concepts to reflect new narrative expansions."
        - "Incorporate user/audience feedback to refine essence patterns or integrators."
        - "Maintain version-controlled storyline documents for continuity management."
        - "Use modular worldbuilding tools to add or remove cultural elements without destabilizing central themes."
        - "Ensure ethical portrayals by consulting cultural advisors and applying moral frameworks to narrative content."
      # No examples as requested

  FutureProofingMechanisms:
    versionControl: "Track document revisions, link changes to narrative shifts."
    modularity: "Add/remove lexicon entries, patterns, guidelines as narrative expands into new media or regions."
    feedbackIncorporation: "Respond to audience analytics, fan theories, co-creator input to enhance narrative richness."
    openExtensions: "Support introduction of new cultures, technologies, mythic layers as universe grows."
